title: glosa citation card
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.8 (Citation Integrity subsystem, generalized to distinction-grain): the Integrity Firewall's two independently-flaggable booleans (metadata_verified != claim_match_verified, NC-18 'source existence != claim support'), `identifier.kind` including BLACKBOX_NOTE (chair ruling C8), `fetch_status` as the ONE enum (chair ruling C3), and the six-value `status` enum. One card per citation USE (one source backing one exact claim at one exact passage), not one card per source document -- templates/knowledge/citation_card.yaml's own header rule. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

claim_match_verified.description: NC-18, non-collapsible boundary: 'source existence != claim support'. Never inferred from metadata_verified.

allOf.description: exact_passage is required whenever claim_match_verified is true (S8 template rule) -- never a paraphrase substituting for the actual check.
status VERIFIED requires both booleans true (Integrity Firewall).
